name: Hastings Village
summary: Hastings Village is a convenient open-air shopping center on East Foothill Boulevard in Pasadena, featuring national retailers and local service providers. With a 4.3-star rating from over 2,400 reviews, this accessible neighborhood center serves the community's everyday shopping and service needs.
demographics: Hastings Village attracts a diverse mix of middle to upper-middle income families and professionals from the Pasadena and East San Gabriel Valley areas. The trade area serves households with median incomes ranging from $75,000 to $125,000, including young professionals, established families, and empty nesters. Shoppers are typically convenience-focused, seeking everyday services and national retailers for routine shopping needs. The center draws from a well-educated demographic reflective of Pasadena's professional workforce, with visitors prioritizing accessibility and familiar brand names for quick shopping trips.
description: Hastings Village is a well-established open-air shopping center located on East Foothill Boulevard in Pasadena, California, serving the community's everyday retail and service needs. This convenient neighborhood center features a carefully curated mix of national retailers and local service providers, making it a go-to destination for residents seeking quality shopping without the hassle of larger regional malls. The center's accessible layout and ample parking create a comfortable shopping experience where customers can easily navigate between stores and complete multiple errands in one visit. With operating hours from 10 AM to 9 PM daily, Hastings Village accommodates busy schedules and provides flexibility for both daytime and evening shoppers. The center has earned a strong reputation in the community, reflected in its 4.3-star rating from over 2,400 reviews, demonstrating consistent customer satisfaction and its role as a trusted retail destination in the Pasadena area.
